details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:127,233 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Both DELETE calls carry `GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true` on a line with `/comments`, which fails `test_idempotent_marker_never_rides_on_creates` (tests/test_workflow_gh_retry_fallback_contract.py:507-515).
  WHY: CI job tests-heal-plan-and-validation fails and the marker is redundant because gh_retry already retries non-POST methods; the source reviewers rated this BLOCKER (mapped to critical). The `"GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true" in text` assertion in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py must also be dropped.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:182-202 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: When the post-create queue-issue re-list fails (lines 191-194), the run silently adopts the issue it just created instead of proceeding unlocked.
  WHY: Racing runs can land on different queue issues and run intake concurrently, which defeats the queue. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet, minimax) vs MAJOR (gemini, luna); highest used.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:25 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `issues`/`opened` exclusion list in clarify.yml, internal-clarify.yml (line 18) and workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml does not exclude `ai:heal-intake-queue`.
  WHY: Clarify runs on the queue issue, spending model budget and possibly relabeling or closing it, which makes the next run create another queue issue.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:156 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: Every `outcome=unlocked` path sends a Telegram WARNING even though the pipeline continues without human action.
  WHY: This breaks the agents.md alert-level convention (DEBUG means the pipeline is already handling the event) and can page repeatedly in a burst; the test's `startswith("WARNING\t")` assertion would need to change with it.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:219-276 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The MAX_WAIT_SECONDS cap is checked only at the bottom of the poll loop, so gh_retry rate-limit waits, the comment-read-failure `continue` (lines 219-224) and the holder-gone `continue` (lines 261-265) bypass it.
  WHY: The wait can overshoot the 4800 s ceiling and hit the 130-minute job timeout, which skips the notify step and loses the report. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet), MAJOR (minimax, luna, gemini on the timeout); highest used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:219-223,276 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: Every waiter polls the queue comments every 20 s with no backoff, regardless of its position.
  WHY: A burst of N waiters costs about N x 240 shared-GH_PAT REST calls and approaches rate limits. Severity disagreement: NIT (minimax) vs MAJOR (gemini, luna); highest used.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh:207-215 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The LIST_ONLY ACTIVE_RUNS gate still zeroes the candidate count when any run is active, without checking HEAL_INTAKE_QUEUE_ENABLED.
  WHY: With the queue on (the default), the scan is skipped instead of waiting in the queue, contradicting the stated rollback-only `intake_busy` skip. Severity disagreement: NIT (sonnet) vs MAJOR (others); highest used.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: unattended_system_instructions.md §20.E/§20.F: every new long-running script must get an entry in docs/scripts-pending-removal.md in the same PR
  expected_change_site: docs/scripts-pending-removal.md
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  EVIDENCE: docs/scripts-pending-removal.md is not in the PR changed-file list, and it has no entry for scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh or the ai:heal-intake-queue issue (existing heal entries at lines 56, 81, 94 do not cover them).
- requirement: "The `intake_busy` skip stays, for the rollback mode; only its comment changed." / the recovery-scan job waits in the same queue
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh (LIST_ONLY ACTIVE_RUNS gate, lines 206-215)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: The ACTIVE_RUNS gate at lines 207-215 is not conditioned on HEAL_INTAKE_QUEUE_ENABLED, so with the queue enabled any active intake run still zeroes the candidate count.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:127,233 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true gh_retry gh api --method DELETE ".../issues/comments/..."` trips test_idempotent_marker_never_rides_on_creates (tests/test_workflow_gh_retry_fallback_contract.py:507-515).
  WHY: CI / lint cannot pass. Drop the prefix from both lines and drop the `"GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true" in text` assertion in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:191-194 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Create-race tie-break: if the re-list read fails, the run uses the issue it just created.
  WHY: Two runs can end up on different queue issues and run intakes concurrently; the effect is bounded to a possible duplicate heal issue.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:219-276 | severity=NIT | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: gh_retry rate-limit waits (up to 600 s) happen inside a poll, and MAX_WAIT_SECONDS is only checked at the bottom of the loop.
  WHY: One poll can overshoot the 4800 s ceiling and hit the 130-minute job timeout, where the `if: failure()` notify step is skipped and the report is lost.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:25 (also internal-clarify.yml, workflow-templates/ai-clarify.yml, tests/test_phase_wrapper_predicate_contract.py) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The `issues`/`opened` exclusion list lacks `ai:heal-intake-queue`.
  WHY: Clarify runs on the queue issue, spends model budget and may relabel it; a closed or changed queue issue makes the next run create another.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:~156 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every outcome=unlocked path sends a Telegram WARNING.
  WHY: This breaks the agents.md alert-level convention and can send many pages in a deep burst.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: unattended_system_instructions.md §20.E/§20.F (registry entry in the same PR) | Expected change site: docs/scripts-pending-removal.md | Evidence of absence: Not in the changed-file list; no entry for scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "Recovery scan. The `intake_busy` skip stays, for the rollback mode; only its comment changed." | Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh, lines 206-214 | Evidence of absence: The ACTIVE_RUNS gate is not conditioned on HEAL_INTAKE_QUEUE_ENABLED; a running intake can starve the hourly scan (delay only). | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- HARDENING: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh ~line 203 (ticket POST) gets a single attempt; retry up to 3 times before `ticket_post_failed` (about 5 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:127,233 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true is used on lines targeting `/issues/comments/`.
  WHY: tests-heal-plan-and-validation fails on test_idempotent_marker_never_rides_on_creates; the marker is redundant because gh_retry retries DELETE by default.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:182-202 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The newly created queue issue is silently selected when the lookup fails.
  WHY: Racing runs can end up on separate queue issues and run intake concurrently.
- .github/workflows/clarify.yml:predicate definition | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `ai:heal-intake-queue` is not excluded from clarify/clarify-respond.
  WHY: Clarify runs on the queue issue, wasting model budget or changing labels so a new queue issue is opened.
- .github/workflows/workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml:97 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Timeout logic for intake waiting in the queue.
  WHY: If wait time plus intake work exceeds the workflow timeout, the job is killed, the notify step is skipped and the report is lost.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:276 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Fixed 20 s poll interval for all waiters.
  WHY: In bursts (17+ reports) this triggers thousands of REST reads against the shared GH_PAT, approaching rate limits.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:156 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Telegram notification on outcome=unlocked is a WARNING.
  WHY: WARNING is for human action; this path proceeds without it, so it should be DEBUG.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: §20.E/§20.F, a docs/scripts-pending-removal.md entry for every new long-running script | Expected change site: docs/scripts-pending-removal.md | Evidence of absence: Not in the changed-file list; no entry for scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh or the ai:heal-intake-queue issue. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "The recovery-scan job waits in the same queue"; the intake_busy skip remains only for rollback mode | Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_recovery_scan.sh | Evidence of absence: The LIST_ONLY active-run gate at lines 207-215 zeroes the candidate count without checking HEAL_INTAKE_QUEUE_ENABLED. | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
=== END FINDINGS FROM google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:127,233 | severity=BLOCKER | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Both lines carry `GH_RETRY_IDEMPOTENT=true` with a `/comments` path, which tests/test_workflow_gh_retry_fallback_contract.py:507-515 rejects.
  WHY: tests-heal-plan-and-validation aborts at line 515 and CI / lint stays red. `_gh_api_args_unsafe_post` returns 1 for non-POST (scripts/gh_helpers.sh:722-724), so the marker is redundant. Drop the prefix and the assertion at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py:377.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:156 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Every outcome=unlocked path pages at WARNING.
  WHY: This violates the agents.md alert-level convention and pages once per report in a burst; a `::warning::` already exists at line 155.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:191-192 | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: When the post-create re-list fails, the run adopts its own freshly created issue.
  WHY: Two such runs hold tickets on different queue issues and run intake concurrently. Suggested fix: `|| _unlocked issue_list_failed`.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal_queue.sh:219-224,261-265 vs 273-275 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The comment-read-failure and holder-gone `continue` paths skip the MAX_WAIT_SECONDS check, so the 4800 s cap is enforced on only one of three loop exits.
  WHY: A failing ticket DELETE can spin the loop with no ceiling until the 130-minute job timeout, and the report is lost.
